text: NAROS, Thessaly — The Thessaly Weir diverts the Morrow river, according to people familiar with the matter. The structure, operated by the Naros Water Authority, sends a regulated share of flow into the South Basin Canal to support irrigation and municipal supply across the eastern plain. The diversion was first authorized in 2018 and expanded after spring floods in 2023, when engineers raised intake capacity to 74 cubic meters a second. Officials declined to comment on maintenance plans for the coming dry season, but people familiar with the matter said crews began inspections this week and expect the gateworks to remain online through September.
